Context: Full reimbursement - HPC cases

## Full reimbursement - HPC cases  
The Composition of High Power Committee, shall be as under:-  
- Chairperson Special Director-General
- 1.
2. Directorate-General, CGHS or his Nominee
3. Additional-Director, CGHS (HQ)/ Addi. DOG (HQ), CGHS
4. Addl.-Director, CGHS (R&H)
5. One Government Specialist \_(of concerned Speciality)
- Member
- Member
- Member Secretary
- Member  
The High Powered Committee shall consider the representations  
of only those CGHS beneficiaries having a valid CGHS Card.
